semantics.points: An arbitrary type V with [Fintype V], Fintype.card V = 88, and an arbitrary [DecidableEq V] instance (the statement quantifies over both instances).
semantics.blocks: B : Finset (Finset V), a set of blocks.  IsDesign B requires every block to have exactly 4 points and every 2-subset {x, y} (x != y) to lie in exactly one block (ExistsUnique).  A repeated block would put each of its pairs in two blocks, so a set of blocks loses nothing for lambda = 1.
semantics.parallel_class: IsParallelClass B P := P ⊆ B and every point lies in exactly one block of P (ExistsUnique).  By DEFINITION a class is a set of blocks of B partitioning the point set.
semantics.resolution: IsResolution B R := every P in R is a parallel class of B (definition above) and every block of B lies in exactly one member of R (ExistsUnique).  By DEFINITION: classes are partitions of the point set into blocks of B, and R partitions B.  NOT in the definition: |P| = 22, |R| = 29, |B| = 638; the proof DERIVES |P| = 22 (PC88.Canonical.class_card) and |R| <= 29 (PC88.Canonical.R_card_le) from the definitions on ZMod 88 (|R| = 29 and |B| = 638 are not needed and not proved).
semantics.image_convention: blockImage σ X := X.map σ.toEmbedding = σ(X) (the image of the block X under the point permutation σ).  The image of a class P is P.image (blockImage σ) = {σ(X) : X ∈ P}; the image of the block set is B.image (blockImage σ).
semantics.automorphism: IsResolutionAut B R σ := B.image (blockImage σ) = B (σ maps the block set onto itself) and for every P in R, P.image (blockImage σ) ∈ R (σ maps every parallel class onto a parallel class of R).  Source wording: "an automorphism of the underlying design that maps each parallel class ... to a parallel class".
semantics.cycle: IsFullCycle σ := σ.IsCycle ∧ σ.support = Finset.univ (Mathlib IsCycle: some point moves and all moved points are in one cycle; with support = univ every point moves, i.e. σ is a single card(V)-cycle).  Source Definition 5: "has an automorphism permuting the points in one cycle".
semantics.point_cyclic_resolution: IsPointCyclicResolution B R := IsDesign B ∧ IsResolution B R ∧ ∃ σ, IsFullCycle σ ∧ IsResolutionAut B R σ.
semantics.target: Target.{u} := ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V], Fintype.card V = 88 → ∀ B R, ¬ IsPointCyclicResolution B R.  The root PC88.Audit.root : PC88.Target.{u} is universe-polymorphic.
semantics.canonical_special_case: CanonicalTarget: V = ZMod 88, σ = Equiv.addRight 1 (x ↦ x + 1).  PC88.Bridge.target_of_canonical proves CanonicalTarget → Target by relabelling along e : ZMod 88 ≃ V, e i = σ^(i.val) x₀, which satisfies e (i + 1) = σ (e i) (PC88.Bridge.exists_equiv_of_fullCycle); PC88.Bridge.canonical_of_target proves Target.{0} → CanonicalTarget (Equiv.addRight 1 is a full cycle, PC88.Bridge.isFullCycle_addRight_one).
semantics.not_hypotheses: T1, class stabilizers 11/22, counts 22/29, short-block structure and the forbidden pair are not hypotheses of any theorem: they are derived inside PC88.Canonical (short_diff, stab_cases, vadd44_of_stab, class_card, R_card_le, card_orb_mul_card_stab, card_dvd_of_free, orbit_short_bound, arith_final, mem8_of_card, false_of_hyp).
